item.title: Copilot Bulletin Monthly #3 — May 2026 · Devs Edition
item.description: May marks the month Copilot became a true multi-surface platform for agentic work. A new desktop app, remote session control going generally available, smarter model routing, and Claude Opus 4.8 landing across all clients signal a shift: developers can now direct parallel agent workflows from any device, in any IDE, without being tied to a single machine or model choice.

item.title: Copilot Bulletin Monthly #2 — April 2026 · Devs Edition
item.description: April was Copilot's most expansive month for developer tooling in 2026. A new frontier model, autonomous agent modes landing in VS Code, JetBrains, and Visual Studio simultaneously, and a public SDK opening Copilot's agent runtime to any application mark a shift from AI assistant to AI platform. Developers can now build with Copilot, not just alongside it.

item.title: Copilot Bulletin Monthly #1 — March 2026 · Devs Edition
item.description: This month, GitHub Copilot's agentic capabilities matured across every developer surface — IDEs, CLI, code review, and the coding agent. Agent hooks, shared memory, and a new agentic architecture for code review give developers more programmable control over AI-assisted workflows, while GPT-5.4 and bidirectional MCP integrations expand what agents can accomplish autonomously.
